reader_summary.overview: This week on The Synopsis, we introduce our Consumer's Hierarchy of Preferences framework in a new episode format. The Consumer's Hierarchy of Preferences is a helpful idea for investors and entrepreneurs to better understand the market, their products, and competitors' offerings. You can check out our original writing introducing the idea here .
